extractor_policies: Secondary histories (Cist, Greene, Palfrey, Woodbury, Ropes, Doubleday, Humphreys, Jordan and Pryor) are coded compiled_total for either side unless the passage shows the figure is visibly an opponent estimate.
NPS forces-engaged cells and frozen CWSAC forces rows carry the table basis reported_engaged and the label derivation_unknown; NPS zero cells are not counts.
A figure attributed to a commander about his own force, when relayed by a compiler, keeps the own_report role.
Force figures from before an engagement (plans, departures, earlier returns) are coded engagement_link_unknown unless the source ties them to the force brought to the engagement.
Extraction is not blind; the complete per-engagement inventory is the structural mitigation (design section 2).
